arms.description: Emit the fixed original ordered pairs and test their evaluation functionals against every D4 monomial image.

arms.description: Fresh exact count of the identical named original input; require six before factorization.

claims.text: All six counted Boolean solutions are roots of the 51 independently exported equations and evaluation at each factors through the accepted D4 quotient map. This proves U subset I(S), but not D5 codimension seven or LFD at least six.

aa.not_applicable_reason: One fixed exact named-input check, no timing comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Synthetic valid-map control passes in the committed unit test; no planted frontier input.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Synthetic corrupted-map and nonroot controls are rejected in the committed unit test; no statistical null population.

decision_rule.text: Report factorization_verified only after fresh count six, six distinct emitted ordered pairs, all 51 equations checked at each point, and all 294204 D4 monomial images checked against induced evaluation functionals. Any other outcome is failed or unknown and gives no seed-vanishing conclusion. A seventh checked D5 quotient direction remains necessary for LFD six.

placement.checkpoint_detail: No checkpoint, restore or automatic retry. Use exclusive frontier locks. 4 GiB address-space cap and 4 GiB host reserve.

inadmissible: Treating six individually valid points as a complete root list without a fresh exact count.
Treating a partial D4 map scan or missing unit basis as factorization.
Inferring D5 codimension seven or LFD at least six from this gate.
Retrying after timeout or bypassing budget, lock, deadline or published-revision gates.
invalidation_rules: Any source, binary, seed, generator or checker hash mismatch prevents execution.
Fresh count other than six or fewer than six distinct valid pairs prevents factorization claim.
Any failed row comparison prevents factorization claim.
Resource, budget, deadline or lock refusal leaves the named gate unknown.

links.launch_gate: Published exact source and plan; exclusive frontier locks; fresh shared daily/monthly budget readback with USD 8 reservation; 4 GiB child cap and 4 GiB reserve; 1 GiB maximum output plus 2 GiB disk reserve; full 6300 seconds before 2026-11-09 23:30 UTC; one attempt and no retry.

literature.claim: If every solution evaluation factors through the D4 quotient, its kernel lies in the vanishing ideal; the D5 lift cannot kill one and retains at least six quotient directions.
A checked D5 quotient dimension greater than six is still necessary to infer LFD at least six for the satisfiable input.
